edge.title: Trust-gated SOAP with denominator floor added on attn.proj weights
edge.summary: Extends #14's SOAP-Muon to the attention output projections (attn.proj; Q/K/V stay on the plain path) with two safeguards. The SOAP denominator is floored at 0.2× its RMS, capping per-coordinate amplification, and the SOAP direction s is mixed with the raw Nesterov momentum m through a scalar trust gate g = clip((cos(s,m) − 0.2)/0.8, 0, 1) · clip(cos(s,grad)/cos(m,grad), 0, 1), clamped to [0.45, 0.85] until step 1375 (floor fading to 0 by 1625, cap 1 afterwards); m + (s − m)·g is rescaled to ‖m‖_F before NS. MLP SOAP, Contra-Muon, NorMuon-lite, the u/w floor and the 3175-step schedule are unchanged; the claim moves from 3150 to 3125.

changes.label: SOAP on attn.proj, denom floor 0.2
changes.detail: SOAP_PARAM_MODE = 'mlp_plus_attn_proj' adds *.attn.proj.weight to the SOAP set; for these soap_precondition_momentum uses denom_floor_ratio = ATTN_SOAP_DENOM_FLOOR = 0.20, clamping the √v denominator to ≥ 0.2·RMS(denominator).

changes.label: Geometric trust gate with bounds
changes.detail: trust_gate multiplies an agreement gate (cos(soap, raw) mapped from [0.2, 1] to [0, 1]) by a gradient-alignment gate cos(soap, grad)/cos(raw, grad); bounded_trust_gate clamps it to [0.45, 0.85] before step 1375, the floor fades linearly to 0 over 1375–1625, then [0, 1].

changes.label: Norm-preserving SOAP/raw blend
changes.detail: norm_preserving_blend forms raw + (soap − raw)·gate and rescales it to the raw momentum's Frobenius norm; the result replaces the momentum fed to muon_update for attn.proj.

changes.label: Claim 3150 → 3125 (3175 scheduled)
changes.detail: train_steps stays 3175 with the same linear cooldown; the record is claimed at the 3125 checkpoint, where the LR is ≈2.2% of peak.

changes.label: Config knobs, screening, logging
changes.detail: Env-overridable constants that reproduce #14 (SOAP_PRECONDITION_FREQUENCY=10, SOAP_DENOM_POWER=0.5, SOAP_BLEND=1.0, SOAP_UPDATE_BEFORE_USE=False, NOR_BETA2=0.95), EARLY_STOP/TARGET_VAL_LOSS screening off by default, val every 2 steps from 3000, LOG_DIR.

edge.parent_check: consistent — nearest-code is #14; #14's MLP SOAP path, Contra-Muon, NorMuon-lite and u/w floor are retained verbatim.

mechanisms.name: Trust-gated SOAP on attn.proj (Trustlight)
mechanisms.explain: attn.proj weights get the same SOAP candidate as the MLP weights, but its √v denominator is clamped to at least 0.2× its RMS so no coordinate is amplified more than ~5× the typical gain. A per-matrix scalar gate multiplies an agreement term (cos(SOAP, raw momentum) rescaled from [0.2, 1]) by a gradient-alignment term (cos(SOAP, grad)/cos(raw, grad), clipped to [0, 1]); it is forced into [0.45, 0.85] before step 1375, the floor fades linearly to 0 by step 1625, and the cap becomes 1 after that. The momentum fed to NS is raw + (SOAP − raw)·gate, rescaled to the raw momentum's Frobenius norm, so stale or disagreeing whitening bases are down-weighted automatically.

caveats: The table reports p=0.34 vs #14, so the 25-step gain over #14 is not significant on its own. The gate is one scalar per matrix computed from global cosines with the raw gradient; at step 0 the SOAP candidate equals the raw momentum (no basis yet). Effective Muon wd 0. The benchmark links a log named fake_log_from_seed0.txt, and the extracted script ends with a stray log-path line (not valid Python). The benchmark README notes that whether the trust gate helps is still unknown.
